properties.notes: Construction of a scheme is now underway to provide 5 new dwellings on an area of waste land that was previously utilised for car parking (17/01752/FUL). Completion is expected for 2020/21. The high density of development is fitting for the location as urban infill scheme. A previous consent to provide 3 flats lapsed without implementation (09/E/00357/FUL).
